rules.description: Nevazu: no browser-only checks for public/auth pages, crawler texts (robots, sitemap, llms, markdown), APIs or authenticated gateway protocols
rules.expression: ((http.host in {"nevazu.com" "www.nevazu.com"} and ((http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/sign-in" "/sign-in/" "/sign-up" "/sign-up/" "/sign-up/complete" "/sign-up/complete/" "/" "/pricing" "/docs" "/status" "/terms" "/privacy" "/refunds" "/contact" "/build-info.json" "/theme-init.js" "/nevazu-favicon.png" "/apple-touch-icon.png" "/favicon.ico" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/llms.txt" "/llms-full.txt" "/home"} or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".md") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/docs/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/"))) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")))) or (http.host eq "connect.nevazu.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/health" "/v1/agent"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/stream/"))))

rules.description: Retired: email requests use app Turnstile; no full-page auth challenge
rules.expression: (http.host in {"nevazu.com" "www.nevazu.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/sign-in" "/sign-in/" "/sign-up" "/sign-up/"} and not cf.client.bot)
